Summary: To check if the application, for IEC101, respects the higher limit of Raw Value for Step Position which is 63
Preconditions: Have two instances of ASE2000 running – Master and RTU, for IEC101 in Task Mode, configured for ‘Step Position’.
Actions:
1. Configure, Connect and Initialize the instances
2. Activate the configured points by issuing ‘General Interrogation’ after inputting the proper Common Addresses.
3. In the ‘Raw Value’ field of the ASDU on the RTU, enter any value which is greater than 63.
Expected Results: The Raw Value must get reset to 63 and the Master also must receive 63.

Summary: To check the working of SBO Relay and other Control Tasks when there is a continuous Static Class Poll happening, with SA disable for DNP3 Serial
Preconditions:
Have two instances of ASE2000 running – Master and RTU in Task Mode,
-> Protocol: DNP3 Serial
-> RTU Points: ‘Binary Output Status’, ‘Analog Output Status’, ‘Binary Input’, ‘Analog Input’
Actions:
1. Initialize: Issue Link Status & Reset Link
2. Start a continuous Static Class Poll
3. Configure the Point Index and issue an SBO Relay.
4. Issue a second SBO Relay
5. Test by issuing other Control Tasks.
Expected Results:
The appropriate sequence of requests and responses for SBO Relay and other Control Tasks tested for must occur everytime, while the continuous class polling stays uninterrupted
If it is not reflecting, then increase the Baud Rate accordingly..

Summary: WDP functionality using send once
Preconditions: Ensure Simulator is running
Actions:
1. Open ASE2000 application in exchange mode with protocol selected as "SunSpec Modbus TCP". In Tools => Properties => SunSpec Modbus TCP tab, add IP as 127.0.0.1 and Port as 502.
2. Open exchange properties of RML and RMPL exchange, provide device id as 1. Click Ok. Use Send once button to issue RML exchange then RMPL exchange.
3. Open Write datapoint exchange, select a model and select some objects. Modify value to another value within the range. Use Send once button to issue the exchange
Expected Results:
1. Verify that write is succesfull by checking the response function code which will be 16(0x10)
2. Verify the request and response frames are as expected and displayed properly in line monitor, messages and object properties
